title: JSFL: doc.group() and doc.ungroup() methods missing
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, doc.group() and doc.ungroup() are not on the JsflDocument interface or proxy. Flash 8 JSFL doc.group() groups the current selection into a group object; doc.ungroup() breaks the selected group apart. The authoring UI already has group/ungroup stage_group and stage_ungroup MCP tools (check MCP tool list). Fix: expose these as JSFL methods on the document proxy that delegate to the existing group/ungroup functionality in the UI.
